title: Craftable Horse Armor
description: This datapack adds the ability to craft copper, iron, golden and diamond horse armor. This is a parity to the leather horse armor.
body:
# Craftable Horse Armor

Craftable Horse Armor is a datapack that allows the crafting of copper, iron, golden and diamond horse armor. The crafting recipe is in parity with the leather horse armor crafting recipe.   
  

## Found a bug or something is not working correctly?  

Send me a message and I will fix it ASAP! :)    
  

## Why did you create this datapack?  

It's more fun if you can kit out your horse any way you want without the hassle of hoping you'll find it in a random dungeon chest!

## Interested in how this datapack is built up?

[This is the link to the GitHub repository.](https://github.com/bdbekhof/CraftableHorseArmor)
